title: Granola closing card
description: A full-bleed art backdrop with a warm oat app-window card rising from the bottom edge: three window dots, a big three-line serif headline, a short paragraph and an ink pill beside an outline pill (stacked full width on phones). The backdrop fades in as the section enters.
notes: the card has no bottom edge: it runs into whatever comes next (the footer in the original)
backdrop is a media slot; empty, a two-tone highlight and lilac field
CSS view timeline fade; without support, or with reduced motion, the backdrop is simply there
